basis: Hand derivation from PRECONTACT conventions; no executable oracle used

oracle_conventions.tree: Nat leaf or array of exactly two child trees
oracle_conventions.labels: unique exact nonnegative integers, same set in both trees
oracle_conventions.graph_bits: edge i is preorder parent-child edge i, left subtree before right
oracle_conventions.q: k-1 only after k>=1; k=0 bounded negative on nonempty valid trees
oracle_conventions.empty: own test oracle refuses empty; eventual candidate API convention pending release

lean_controls.clean: Kernel checked theorem on own computable Nat datum, no custom axioms; complete nonproof body retained
lean_controls.private_unused_axiom: must detect a private axiom even absent from the public theorem dependency closure
lean_controls.opaque_hidden_axiom: must traverse the actual stored opaque body and detect its axiom reference
lean_controls.proof_dependency: omit proof text only after traversing its real full value expression; a dependency hidden only in theorem proof must be present
lean_controls.duplicate_nonproof: same declaration name with values 1 and 2 in separate modules; audit producer data from both import orders, rejecting ambiguity or compiler refusal, never treating one silently selected value as globally unique
lean_controls.manifest: clean rows pass; missing/duplicate row, wrong source path/hash, wrong binary path/hash, wrong producer path/hash, truncated body and unknown declaration references all reject
lean_controls.axiom_trust: Lean/Init/compiler explicitly trusted; custom axiom/sorryAx forbidden regardless of theorem reachability

finite_expansion.initial_exhaustive: all unordered sibling rooted labeled binary trees on 0..n-1 and all ordered pairs for n=3 then n=4
